## Overview

**Cassian Aurelius** — a half-elf cleric who served as the Maximus of the researchers of the Sunforged Legion during the era of the First Alliance. He was selected as one of the seven Alliance heroes entrusted with defeating Khar'Zul. He is a direct ancestor of Marcellus Aurelius, the current Maximus of the Sunforged Legion.

---

## Fate

Cassian survived both battles against Khar'Zul and the sealing ritual.
